desc:
Shutdown = Update or something (always check the update log)

CSG Slicing Engine is, for the most part, a PVE focused, first/third person fighting game, featuring brutal combat, a wide range of melee and ranged weapons, semi-realistic ragdoll physics, (unrealistic) blood, horror elements, secrets, wonder-weapons, and other fun mechanics. This game makes use of Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) to simulate damage, which is the project's core feature. For the best experience, it is recommended to set the graphics to level 10. You can have some (limited) control over performance via the settings menu.
